review.notes: The prior independent review supplied reproductions. Test synthetic launchd and real Doctor dispatch, and separately check baseline admission in an isolated mixed-version fixture. No physical reboot, login-item or power-off claims.

cases.description: Recover a previously loaded job across the pre-bootout restart boundary
cases.setup: Use a synthetic HOME, release-shaped profile, and a distinct process that retains installation and plan state across entries
cases.action: Invoke the real macOS Doctor command on both continue and cancel with the profile held and launchd restarted
cases.expected: The original loaded job returns exactly once after the profile, and a cancellation preserves the v2 layout.

cases.description: Fence pre-upgrade CLI admission throughout the parked-profile window
cases.setup: Use a synthetic grouped home and a participant with baseline storage-command admission and remote-off behavior
cases.action: Attempt remote-off before, during, and after the parking fence across application reentry
cases.expected: An admitted old participant can stop actual installed jobs. While profiles are parked, the baseline rejects admission. The next Doctor never recreates a removed profile or reopens newly disabled access.

cases.description: End an interactive cleanup retry with the exit code of the cleanup
cases.setup: Use a verified plan with a failed directory sync after unlink in a synthetic home
cases.action: Rerun the actual Doctor command from a standalone PTY, then check the next dispatch
cases.expected: The retry verifies and reports cleanup without invoking ordinary repair or replaying services. A later ordinary invocation retains its original behavior.

cases.description: Guide a verified custom gtmux installation without weakening ownership checks
cases.setup: A release-shaped profile points to an executable from a custom install prefix
cases.action: Inspect using another binary and then the same custom CLI identity
cases.expected: The unmatched install is left unchanged with specific guidance. Using the registering installation still requires the loaded identity to agree.
